name: Copilot Hackathon

onCreateCommand.copilot-cli: curl -fsSL https://gh.io/copilot-install | bash || echo 'Copilot CLI install failed; see docs/FACILITATOR.md'

postAttachCommand.welcome: echo '\nReady. Run: python -m pytest   then open labs/00-setup/README.md\n'

DATAVERSE_URL.description: Dataverse Web API base URL. Needed only for Lab 05.

DATAVERSE_TENANT_ID.description: Entra tenant ID for the Dataverse environment. Needed only for Lab 05.

DATAVERSE_CLIENT_ID.description: Application ID of the Dataverse app user. Needed only for Lab 05.

DATAVERSE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret for the Dataverse app user. Supplied as an organization secret; never commit it.

//: Everything an attendee needs is here, so no laptop install is required and every person gets
an identical environment. Node and the Copilot CLI live in the container.
organizationCustomAgents is what makes the shared vendor-analyst agent appear.
Dependencies install in updateContentCommand so a prebuild can cache them, and waitFor holds
the editor until that finishes: otherwise the first pytest run fails on a half-built venv.
